map: LOC 12th Army Group situation map, 6 Jan 1945

units.result: record [5.2, 50.1]  reader [5.17, 50.21]  12 km  DIFFERS  note: Dashed XX box marked AB with 6 (+) beside it, just north of Rochefort; the dashed outline fits a British (21 Army Group) unit.

record [5.36, 50.1]  reader [5.33, 50.08]  3 km  ok  note: Hatched XX box with an armor oval inside, numbered 2, east of the line south east of Rochefort. The similar hatched box above it near 5.36E 50.15N is numbered 9.

readerNotes.line: In the west the ticked line meets the heavy east west army group boundary near 5.24E 50.15N; the heavy unticked line running west from there is the boundary and was not counted. North end where the heavy line comes down near the Maas at about 5.84E; the Westwall hatching near Aachen was not used. The south east end leaves the east edge near Saarlautern; a heavy line running south from there toward Metz looks like a boundary and was not followed. Line thinned to 38 points.
